matchmaking_summary: Kelly Simard is a seasoned Human Resources professional with over nine years of experience in both union and non-union environments, demonstrating expertise across multiple HR domains including recruitment, training & development, employee relations, benefits administration, and payroll. With a strong background in managing diverse teams and handling sensitive information with confidentiality and neutrality, Kelly has honed her skills in problem solving, leadership, and communication through various roles. Her proficiency extends to utilizing a variety of HR systems and software, such as Hire Centric, Onboarding Hire Centric, Auto-Bene, Taleo, Successfactors, Core, and ADI Time, further illustrating her adaptability and technology prowess within the HR landscape.
